next:or:833.hint: 結婚している状態を表す表現
next:or:833.question: She [[has got married to]] him for ten years.
next:or:833.fullSentence: She has been married to him for ten years.
next:or:833.explanation: be married to A『Aと結婚している』(状態)。
next:or:833.relatedInfo: get married to A『結婚する』(動作)との対比。

next:or:834.hint: 彼は父親によく似ている
next:or:834.explanation: resemble Aは他動詞で前置詞不要(×resemble with A)。
next:or:834.relatedInfo: 進行形にしない状態動詞の一つ。

next:or:835.hint: 謝罪の対象と理由を示す前置詞句
next:or:835.question: I [[apologized her for]] being late.
next:or:835.fullSentence: I apologized to her for being late.
next:or:835.explanation: apologize to A for B『AにBのことで謝る』。
next:or:835.relatedInfo: apologizeは自動詞なので目的語を直接とらない。

next:or:836.hint: 彼らはお金について言い争った
next:or:836.fullSentence: They argued with each other about money.
next:or:836.explanation: argue with A about B『AとBについて言い争う』。

next:or:837.hint: 苦情の対象と内容を示す前置詞句
next:or:837.question: She [[complained the manager about]] the noise.
next:or:837.fullSentence: She complained to the manager about the noise.
next:or:837.explanation: complain to A about B『AにBについて苦情を言う』。

next:or:838.hint: 彼は有名な大学を卒業した
next:or:838.fullSentence: He graduated from a famous university.
next:or:838.relatedInfo: 日本語の『卒業する』と違い、fromが必要。

next:or:839.question: She [[succeeded to pass]] the exam.
next:or:839.fullSentence: She succeeded in passing the exam.
next:or:839.relatedInfo: succeed to=(地位などを)継承するとの混同に注意。

next:or:840.hint: 私たちは空港に2時間早く着いた
next:or:840.fullSentence: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
next:or:840.explanation: arrive at/in ~ ＝ get to ~ ＝ reach ~(reachは他動詞で前置詞不要)。
next:or:840.relatedInfo: 狭い場所にはat、広い場所にはinを使う。

next:or:841.hint: reachが他動詞であることの確認
next:or:841.question: It took us three hours to [[reach to the summit]].
next:or:841.fullSentence: It took us three hours to reach the summit.
next:or:841.explanation: reach ~は他動詞なので前置詞は不要(×reach to)。
next:or:841.relatedInfo: arrive at/inとの語法の違いに注意。

next:or:842.fullSentence: The sun rises in the east.
next:or:842.explanation: rise-rose-risen(自動詞)『上がる』。他動詞raiseとの語形・意味の対比。
next:or:842.relatedInfo: raiseは目的語を必要とする他動詞。

next:or:843.question: He [[rose]] his hand to ask a question.
next:or:843.fullSentence: He raised his hand to ask a question.
next:or:843.relatedInfo: rise(自動詞)との語形の対比。

next:or:844.hint: 猫は一日中ソファに横たわっていた
next:or:844.fullSentence: The cat lay on the sofa all day.
next:or:844.explanation: lie-lay-lain(自動詞)『横たわる』の過去形。他動詞layとの語形・意味の対比。
next:or:844.relatedInfo: lay(横たえる)の原形と紛らわしい点に注意。

next:or:845.question: She [[lay]] the baby on the bed gently.
next:or:845.fullSentence: She laid the baby on the bed gently.
next:or:845.explanation: lay-laid-laid(他動詞)『〜を横たえる、置く』。
next:or:845.relatedInfo: lie(自動詞)との語形の対比。

next:or:846.hint: お願いを聞いてもらえますか
next:or:846.fullSentence: Will you do me a favor?
next:or:846.explanation: do A B ＝ do B for A『AにBをしてやる』。favorは『頼み事』の意味。
next:or:846.relatedInfo: ＝May I ask a favor of you?

next:or:847.hint: 時間や物を割いてもらうことを表す動詞
next:or:847.question: Can you [[spare a few minutes to me]]?
next:or:847.fullSentence: Can you spare me a few minutes?
next:or:847.wrongPart: spare a few minutes to me
next:or:847.relatedInfo: 忙しい相手に時間を求めるときの定番表現。

next:or:848.hint: この近道で多くの時間を節約できる
next:or:848.fullSentence: This shortcut will save us a lot of time.
next:or:848.relatedInfo: save A the trouble of doingで『〜する手間を省く』。

next:or:849.question: It [[cost a fortune to me]] to repair the car.
next:or:849.fullSentence: It cost me a fortune to repair the car.
next:or:849.explanation: cost AB『AにBの費用がかかる』(It costs A B to do)。

next:or:850.hint: レポートを終えるのに3時間かかった
next:or:850.fullSentence: It took me three hours to finish the report.
next:or:850.explanation: take AB『AにBの時間がかかる』(It takes A B to do)。
next:or:850.relatedInfo: costとtakeの語順パターンが似ている。

next:or:851.question: The store [[charged twice the usual price to me]].
next:or:851.answer: charged me twice the usual price
next:or:851.fullSentence: The store charged me twice the usual price.
next:or:851.wrongPart: charged twice the usual price to me
next:or:851.relatedInfo: chargeも第4文型(SVOO)をとる動詞の一つ。

next:or:852.hint: お金を少し貸してもらえますか
next:or:852.fullSentence: Could you lend me some money?
next:or:852.relatedInfo: borrow(借りる)との混同に注意。

next:or:853.question: He [[told to me an interesting story]].
next:or:853.fullSentence: He told me an interesting story.
next:or:853.wrongPart: told to me an interesting story
next:or:853.relatedInfo: sayはSVOOの形をとれない点との対比。

next:or:854.hint: 彼女はその計画について私に何も言わなかった
next:or:854.fullSentence: She said nothing to me about the plan.
next:or:854.explanation: sayはSVOO不可(×say me nothing)。say B to Aの形をとる点でtellと対比。
next:or:854.relatedInfo: tell(SVOO可)との違いを整理する。

next:or:855.hint: discussは前置詞不要な他動詞
next:or:855.question: We [[discussed about the problem]] for hours.
next:or:855.fullSentence: We discussed the problem for hours.
next:or:855.explanation: discussは他動詞でaboutは不要(×discuss about)。talk about Bとの対比。
next:or:855.relatedInfo: 頻出の語法ミスとして有名。

next:or:856.hint: 彼はチームに支援を約束した
next:or:856.fullSentence: He promised his support to the team.
next:or:856.explanation: promise A B ＝ promise B to A(toを使うグループ)。
next:or:856.relatedInfo: buy/read/sendも同様の書き換えパターンを持つ。

next:or:857.hint: 説得を表すpersuade A into doing
next:or:857.question: She [[persuaded him to joining]] the club.
next:or:857.fullSentence: She persuaded him into joining the club.
next:or:857.explanation: persuade A into doing ＝ persuade A to do。
next:or:857.relatedInfo: talk A into doingとも似た形。
